column7: Pins the allowed half of Andrei's 2026-10-11 decision (ADR-042 addendum): a restricted PAT may DELETE /api/v1/auth/tokens/{id} and /api/v1/auth/sessions/{id} for its OWNER's own credentials (204, and the revoked credential stops authenticating) and gets 404 for another user's, which keep working. Revoking only reduces access. Not a fix: it guards against the decision regressing in either direction. Mutation-checked: dropping RevokeOwnPAT's ownership check goes red ("another user's PAT must survive"), and refusing revokes for restricted PATs goes red (expected 204). PAT-GUARD-2
